name: Cá sủ
summary: Cá sủ is sold by the kilogram on the 20 June 2013 board. The board also prints cá sủ sao. The 8 January 2016 article says the island’s seafood is best in winter, before the spring spawn.
howToEat: Order it by weight. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the streets on the 20 June 2013 board. A current door is Check on arrival. The 20 June 2013 board is a price list. A current price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cá sủ on the Cat Ba board
seoDescription: Cá sủ, and cá sủ sao, are on the 20 June 2013 Cat Ba board by the kilogram. A current price is Check on arrival.
